operations.name: chat
operations.purpose: Generate one reply from an AI record to user text, with call-duration memory.
operations.output: string reply. Varied by design; never substring-matched.
errors: none thrown; unknown input falls back to fallback lines
operations.note: Replies intentionally varied; whole-word intent matching, never substring.

operations.name: dial
operations.purpose: Open a live dial-up session with an AI (greeting, say/runDemo/lockRole/hangup, transcript).
operations.permissions: none — in-memory session only; nothing persisted, nothing sent
operations.note: Session IDs JAH-SESSION-######; SESSION MEMORY dies at hangup, never persisted.

operations.name: runDemo
operations.purpose: Run an AI's working demo script with given inputs; returns the result string.
operations.output: string result; deterministic per demo kind
errors: none thrown; guided demos narrate the input list

operations.name: runDemoReceipt
operations.purpose: runDemo plus a permanent demo receipt (JAH-DEMO-######).
operations.output: receipt object {demo_id, ai_id, demo_kind, inputs, output, versions, ran_at}

operations.name: presets
operations.purpose: List the 6 built-in archetype presets (one model of each kind).
operations.note: 6 archetypes, one model of each kind.

operations.name: loadPreset
operations.purpose: Load one preset by name (older names resolve via permanent aliases); returns a fresh copy.
operations.output: preset record, or null if unknown
operations.note: Older preset names resolve via permanent aliases.

operations.name: geneOptions
operations.purpose: List The Opperater's gene slots and boxes (10 slots x 18 = 180; advanced unlocks more).
operations.output: array of slot objects {key, name, mirror, options[]}
operations.note: 10 main gene slots x 18 boxes = 180; advanced slots add more.

operations.name: genomeViable
operations.purpose: Check whether a set of gene codes covers all viability groups.

operations.name: buildGenome
operations.purpose: Forge an AI genome record from chosen gene codes (deterministic).
operations.input: {genes: {SLOT: code}, name, kind, advanced?} — full or partial slot map
operations.output: AI record {id, name, stamp JAH-AI-OPR-XXXX, genome_id JAH-GENOME-XXXXXX, ...}
operations.note: Same inputs => same genome record and genome_id.

operations.name: fileRecord
operations.purpose: Stamp a genome/preset as a filed AI record (JAH-AI-OP-######) with downloadable .py/.json. Local-first: nothing saved or published.
operations.note: Stamp + filedAt differ per call; record content otherwise stable. Local-first: nothing saved or published.

operations.name: tones
operations.purpose: List the available speech tone presets.

operations.name: labCatalogs
operations.purpose: List the 8 Creation Lab shelves (separate from the 10 Opperater gene slots).
operations.note: 8 Creation Lab shelves (separate from the 10 Opperater gene slots).

operations.name: labOptions
operations.purpose: Options for one shelf (paginated).

operations.name: animateCreation
operations.purpose: Animate a creation from a base archetype + shelf picks (deterministic: same picks => same record).
operations.output: creation record {stamp JAH-LAB-XXXXXX, name, description, svg, abilities, ...}
errors: unknown base falls back to a blank slab — never throws
operations.note: Same base + picks => byte-identical creation record and stamp.

operations.name: creationToAI
operations.purpose: Turn a creation record into a dialable AI record.

operations.name: labDemo
operations.purpose: Scripted field-test simulation for a creation (narrative, not a measurement).
operations.note: Scripted simulation — not a real measurement.

operations.name: recordHash
operations.purpose: Deterministic content hash of a record (excludes volatile filing fields).
operations.note: Content hash excluding volatile filing fields.

operations.name: capabilities
operations.purpose: Machine-readable capability discovery: operations, catalog counts, offline claim.

operations.name: health
operations.purpose: Lightweight status probe (full suite is selfTest).
operations.note: Quick probe; full suite is selfTest().

operations.name: selfTest
operations.purpose: Run the full engine self-test suite (PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL, per-item results).
operations.permissions: none — bumps the in-memory file-stamp counter as a side effect of testing fileRecord
operations.note: Full check suite. Chat replies are intentionally NON-deterministic; everything else deterministic.

compatibility.api_versioning: api_version is pinned at 2.0. Breaking changes bump it; additive functions never do.
compatibility.presets: Older preset names resolve via permanent PRESET_ALIASES; removed names keep aliases.
compatibility.records: JAH-LAB-###### / JAH-AI-OP-###### / JAH-GENOME-###### / JAH-DEMO-###### / JAH-SESSION-###### formats are permanent.
